data.name: Poisonous Nature
data.description: Whenever you have a bite attack, you can choose to have it apply the following poison to any successful bite atatck: [frequency 1 round (6), effect 1 Con damage, cure 1 save, DC %1]. If you already have this poison, increase the damage to 1d3 Con damage and increase the DC by +2.  This poison can be used on %2 attacks per day.|PoisonousNaturePoisonDC|PoisonousNatureTimes
